text:
incident-bot: PAGER: [P1] AP-CENTRAL1 GPU capacity exhausted — autoscaler hitting cloud quota limits, new instances denied. Pager routed to Ben (oncall). Priority: drop-in mitigation and customer-impact assessment. https://internal.incident/7301234567 :rotating_light:
Ben (oncall): acked, on it. seeing repeated `QuotaExceeded` from GCP when requesting GPUs. queue length up ~1.9k pending jobs, latency spike reported by console :chart_with_upwards_trend:.
Alice (sre): joining — logs show autoscaler API calls failing with 403: rateLimitExceeded / quotaExceeded. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z autoscaler: createInstance failed: code=403, message=Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project xxxxxx in region us-central1
```
Charlie (infra): quick note — quota for this billing account in ap-central1 is at hard limit. We have no spare quota to request additional GPUs. I can try temporary cross-region routing or spin up non-GPU warm pools.
Ben (oncall): customers hitting inference timeouts on hosted endpoints. Are fallbacks enabled to smaller CPU-backed models?
Alice (sre): some routes have fallback policies but they rely on model variant compatibility. I'm toggling a policy to route non-critical low-qps requests to cpu-optimized endpoints to relieve queue. Doing a gradual 30% shift now.
Danielle (support): we already have 3 customer tickets about elevated tail latency and OOMs. SLO dashboard shows error rate ~8% for ap-central1. Need a customer-visible note if this is long.
Maya (product): flagging churn risk for PLG customers. If this persists >2hr, we should prepare a short status message.
Alice (sre): mitigation step 1: enable fallback routing (30% -> CPU) applied. step 2: reduce concurrency per-worker from 4 -> 2 for GPU-backed tasks to let scheduling free GPUs faster. Applying knob now.
deploy-bot: deploy 5f3a2b applied to autoscaler-config (concurrency=2) — rollout 10% -> 100%.
Ben (oncall): doing live check on queue after initial changes. current queue: 1920 -> 1480 after 8m. token cost down, but still above safe threshold 500.
Charlie (infra): I'll attempt emergency quota request to GCP now (filed support case 2009876543) and start an emergency warm-pool in us-west1 with identical models to handle overflow. It will take ~12-18m to be ready.
Alice (sre): note: autoscaler errors persist for new machine requests (same quota 403). For now we rely on routing and warm-pools. Also enabling aggressive prefix KV cache for chat workloads to reduce consecutive token generation.
Ben (oncall): customer-impact summary: internal dashboards show 11 customers with >30% error increase, 4 customers with critical latency impacting user flows. Escalated to CS leads.
Danielle (support): patched top-4 affected customers with targeted rate-limit relax/priority downgrade to reduce failed calls. Also sending personalized updates.
Maya (product): please draft status blurb for status.redwood.ai with ETA "mitigations in progress, possible degraded performance" — keep it short.
Ben (oncall): creating bridge for next shift handoff at +2h. Who's taking next oncall? Charlie usually covers infra at night.
Charlie (infra): I'll stay until warm-pool up, then hand off to Alice for monitoring. Starting cross-region warm pool now: creating instances in us-west2 without GPU limit issues.
Alice (sre): after routing+concurrency change queue falling but tail latency still 95th=1.2s above baseline 0.3s. Keeping CPU fallbacks enabled. Recommend throttling non-urgent background evaluation jobs to free capacity — tagging and throttling now.
Ben (oncall): setting incident severity to P1 -> mitigation in progress. tagging incident runbook: /runbooks/gpu-quota-limits.
deploy-bot: warm-pool blueprint applied in us-west2 (id wp-9923). bootstrapping models (approx 14m remaining).
Charlie (infra): warm-pool started; health checks failing initially due to model download throttles, retrying with staggered pulls.
Alice (sre): observed 60% drop in new failures after CPU fallback fully rolled out. Still watching queue; once warm-pool is healthy I'll start draining queue to it.
Danielle (support): customer comms sent to 7 impacted accounts. Saved templates used. Some customers asked for ETA; replied with "mitigations underway, expect improvements within 30-45 minutes, full recovery may take longer depending on cloud quotas."
Ben (oncall): current snapshot: queue 620 pending, error rate 2.7% (downgraded from 8%), warm-pool capacity 40% warmed, cross-region routing latency +40ms median — acceptable.
Maya (product): thanks team. Flag for postmortem: quota forecasting failed for ap-central1 burst. Add follow-ups: quota increase requests, region throttling policy, better graceful-degradation routes.
Alice (sre): plan for handoff: I'll stay 20m to ensure warm-pool drains queue to safe levels, then hand to Charlie for infra cleanup and to Ben for post-incident triage notes.
Danielle (support): closing customer loop: will send follow-up update in 45m with recovery summary.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations reduced impact. Monitoring. Incident will remain open for postmortem actions.
Ben (oncall): last note before handoff: created short-living postmortem draft at /incidents/7301234567/draft. We'll finalize after root cause and quota outcomes. :white_check_mark:
Alice (sre): last check: queue 280 -> continuing drain. handing to Charlie in 12m.
Charlie (infra): confirmed warm-pool healthy at 60%. I'll continue monitoring scaling errors and chase quota.
Danielle (support): final customer update queued.
Ben (oncall): closing active paging loop — oncall remains for followups. Good job team. :clap:
